body:
## Rationale

`packages/frontend/data/drummerEvolution.js`'s most recent era for Nicko McBrain (`nicko-mcbrain-2010-sonor`, "Sonor Era", 2010–Present) is stale: it was never updated when McBrain switched brands. Iron Maiden is one of the highest-TAM entities on the roster. Same systemic staleness/fabrication pattern already fixed for Matt Garstka (#5806) and Ray Luzier (#5807) — in this case the file simply never picked up a real, documented later switch.

### The contradiction

**Wrong/stale (`drummerEvolution.js:14354-14424`, era `nicko-mcbrain-2010-sonor`, claims "2010–Present"):**
- `drums`: "Sonor SQ1 / SQ2" (line ~14367)
- `cymbals`: "Paiste Signature Series (evolved)" with "15" Sound Edge Hi-Hats, 16"/18"/19" Full Crashes, 22" Power Ride, 18" Thin China, 10" Splash" (line ~14380)
- The era's own `description` and FAQ text assert this is his current setup as of Senjutsu (2021) and beyond.

**Correct, per `api/drummers/index.js:2440-2452` (`kitOverview`/`gear`) and `packages/frontend/data/extendedBios.js:3737-3741` (`gearHighlights`), which agree with each other:**
- `extendedBios.js:3737`: "Nicko McBrain **was** a longtime Sonor Drums endorser **and is now a British Drum Co. artist**." — i.e. the file itself documents the switch away from Sonor.
- `api/drummers/index.js:2442` (`gear.drums`): "British Drum Co."
- Cymbals: `api/drummers/index.js:2450`: "Paiste 2002 & Signature Series (14" Sound Edge Hi-Hats, 16" & 18" Power Crashes, 22" Power Ride, 20" China)" — different hi-hat size (14" not 15"), no splash, has a 20" China `drummerEvolution.js` omits.
- Snare (Sonor Nicko McBrain Signature 14"×6.5") and sticks (Vic Firth Nicko McBrain Signature) are consistent between the two files — no change needed there, since McBrain's snare stayed Sonor even after the drums switch to British Drum Co.

## Exact edits needed

File: `packages/frontend/data/drummerEvolution.js`, era `nicko-mcbrain-2010-sonor` (~lines 14354-14424)

1. Add a new, later era (e.g. `nicko-mcbrain-20XX-british-drum-co`) — or update this era's end-bound and rename/reframe it — reflecting the switch from Sonor to British Drum Co. drums, keeping the Sonor signature snare. Determine the approximate switch year from `extendedBios.js`/external sourcing if available; if not independently datable, keep a single "current era" entry but correct the drum brand rather than inventing a date.
2. `gear.drums.item`: "Sonor SQ1 / SQ2" → "British Drum Co."; rewrite `details`/`notes` accordingly (drop the "North American maple shells" SQ-specific description unless British Drum Co.'s actual shell spec can be verified).
3. `gear.cymbals.item` `details`: correct hi-hat size to 14" (not 15"), remove the 10" splash (not documented in either source of truth), add the 20" China documented in `api/drummers/index.js:2450`.
4. Update the `keyChanges` bullet "Moved to Sonor SQ1/SQ2 custom drums, ending decades on Ludwig and Premier" and the FAQ answer at the bottom of the Nicko McBrain block (currently says "Nicko McBrain currently plays a Sonor SQ1/SQ2 kit...") to reflect British Drum Co. as current.
5. Leave `snare` (Sonor Nicko McBrain Signature 14"×6.5") and `sticks` (Vic Firth Nicko McBrain Signature) unchanged — both already correct.

## Verify

1. `grep -n "Sonor SQ1" packages/frontend/data/drummerEvolution.js` — should not describe Nicko McBrain's *current* drums after the fix (a historical Sonor-era entry preceding the British Drum Co. switch is fine if added).
2. Nicko McBrain's current-era `gear.drums` reads "British Drum Co.", matching `api/drummers/index.js:2442` and `extendedBios.js:3740`.
3. Cymbal `details` match `api/drummers/index.js:2450` exactly (14" hi-hats, 16"/18" crashes, 22" ride, 20" china, no splash).
4. Live-curl `/drummers/nicko-mcbrain/evolution` (bot UA) and the FAQ block after deploy to confirm both show British Drum Co., not Sonor, as current.

## Done

Nicko McBrain's `drummerEvolution.js` current-era drums/cymbals and the block's FAQ answer match `api/drummers/index.js` and `extendedBios.js` (British Drum Co. drums, correct Paiste cymbal spec) — no stale "Sonor is current" claim remains.
title: SEO: Nicko McBrain drummerEvolution.js — stale 'Sonor Era' entry vs. verified current British Drum Co. kit
